purpose: Decompose the remaining calibrated-hybrid vs qwen-switch-oracle gap so the next research step is based on current support-preserving headroom, not on a generic GPU assumption.

decision.next_step: Do not spend on a selector-only GPU run. Build the next zero/low-cost packet around support-preserving candidate generation or repair, and only rent Prime once a generator packet can plausibly add more supported answer candidates beyond the small oracle gap.
decision.reason: The oracle selector headroom over the calibrated hybrid is only three net judged-correct rows on the final window, and existing local heuristic/ranker signals fail to identify supported candidates reliably enough. Selector work alone is unlikely to produce a NeurIPS-grade result.

llm_budget.note: This decomposition reads existing selector predictions, inherited judgments, and local budget artifacts only.
